description: This file defines a class 'RuleChainsTableConfigResolver' that configures and manages the display and actions for rule chain entities within a UI table, including loading, saving, deleting, and various rule chain operations, with support for different rule chain scopes such as tenant, edge, and edges.

classes.name: RuleChainsTableConfigResolver
classes.description: A resolver class that configures the rule chains table, managing data loading, user actions, and UI behavior for rule chain entities within different scopes.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Configures the table based on route parameters and data, setting entity scope, columns, fetch functions, and actions.

methods.name: configureEntityTableColumns
methods.description: Defines the columns displayed in the rule chains table depending on the scope.

methods.name: configureAddActions
methods.description: Defines the actions available for adding rule chains, such as creating, importing, or assigning to edges.

methods.name: configureEntityFunctions
methods.description: Returns the function to fetch rule chains based on scope.

methods.name: configureTableTitle
methods.description: Generates the table title based on scope and edge information.

methods.name: configureGroupActions
methods.description: Defines group actions like unassigning rule chains from an edge.

methods.name: configureCellActions
methods.description: Defines actions available per cell, such as export, set root, assign to edge, etc.

methods.name: importRuleChain
methods.description: Handles importing a rule chain, navigating to import page after import.

methods.name: openRuleChain
methods.description: Navigates to the detailed view of a specific rule chain.

methods.name: saveRuleChain
methods.description: Saves a rule chain, setting its type if undefined.

methods.name: exportRuleChain
methods.description: Exports a rule chain by ID.

methods.name: setRootRuleChain
methods.description: Sets a rule chain as the root, with confirmation dialog.

methods.name: onRuleChainAction
methods.description: Handles various user actions on rule chains, such as open, export, set root, etc.

methods.name: setEdgeTemplateRootRuleChain
methods.description: Sets a rule chain as the edge template root, with confirmation.

methods.name: checkMissingToRelatedRuleChains
methods.description: Checks for missing related rule chains for an edge and alerts if any.

methods.name: assignRuleChainsToEdge
methods.description: Opens dialog to assign rule chains to an edge.

methods.name: unassignFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns a rule chain from an edge with confirmation.

methods.name: unassignRuleChainsFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns multiple rule chains from an edge.

methods.name: setAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Sets auto-assign rule chain to an edge.

methods.name: unsetAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Removes auto-assign rule chain from an edge.

methods.name: isNonRootRuleChain
methods.description: Checks if a rule chain is non-root, considering scope.

methods.name: isAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Checks if a rule chain is auto-assigned to an edge.

methods.name: isNotAutoAssignToEdgeRuleChain
methods.description: Checks if a rule chain is not auto-assigned to an edge.

methods.name: fetchRuleChains
methods.description: Fetches core rule chains.

methods.name: fetchEdgeRuleChains
methods.description: Fetches auto-assign edge rule chains and then core rule chains.
